title: Poly (Plantronics) CS540 Wireless DECT Headset, Single Ear (Mono), New

comparisons.notes: New condition, 12 in stock. Poly CS540, HP 7W073AA#ABA, the replacement part number for Plantronics 84693-01.
New, shown as available. MPN 84693-01 / HP 7W073AA#ABA; includes headset, base, headband, ear-loop kit and RJ9 cable.

writeup: The Poly CS540 (formerly Plantronics, MPN 84693-01) is a wireless DECT desk phone headset that weighs about 21 grams and gives you up to 350 feet of range from its base. Woot has it brand new for $69.99, while PC Liquidations charges $159.99 and Reef Telecom $164.99 for the same headset. Limit 25 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Woot listing ASIN B005HS5MKS verified upstream as the exact Plantronics CS540 84693-01 listing.
